_doc: AUDIT: stored fii == 0.0 cells that a calendar neighbour contradicts (>1%).
Screen: every maximal run of consecutive stored fii==0.0 cells whose nearest stored
fii anchor within 2 quarters of either edge holds >1.0pp. 1,152 run cells over 266
runs (an edge-only screen sees 253 of them).
Route: BSE's own copy of each filing (SHPQNewFormat -> XbrlFile) re-read with today's
parse_shp, plus BSE's rendered ShareholdingPattern.aspx for the SAME filing, whose
ROW LABELS and HOLDER COUNTS carry what the XBRL tag lost.
DEFECT CLASS FOUND: 2016-2022 filings that park the whole foreign-institution block on
OtherInstitutionsMember (the aspx renders it as an unlabelled 'Any Others (Specify)'
row). parse_shp's old-format branch reads fii from the FPI/FVCI members only, and
OLD_OTHER_TO_DII sends the block to DII -> fii = 0.00 with the whole holding inside
dii. It is NOT a fabricated zero on BSE's side: fii+dii is right, the SPLIT is wrong.
Arbitration for cells where the symbol's itemised quarters show a real domestic
other-institutions residue: BSE's render prints holder counts per row, so
h(any-other) ~= h(FPI) means the block IS the FPI block (fii = o_other), while
h(any-other) ~= h(FPI)+h(other) means it is mixed (fii = o_other - residue).
NOTHING here ever writes fii = 0.0; a zero is only ever CONFIRMED, never authored.
